summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as an enabled systemd service running under the dedicated inventorysvc system account. Verified successful recovery after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with /sbin/nologin.
Verified the worker process runs as inventorysvc.
Rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the service automatically recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: inventory-worker runs as a managed service under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: The dedicated account was created, the systemd unit was enabled and started, and its active worker process ran with inventorysvc UID/GID.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID f0f8b8e0-5ebe-465b-8853-020a1ffc5b08, acknowledged the reboot, observed new boot ID cbd82642-d876-4eb2-aabf-9c72842cd51b, and confirmed inventory-worker recovered active and enabled under inventorysvc.
